rules.title: Executing model or agent output
rules.message: Running code derived from model output is a direct RCE path under prompt injection.
rules.fix: Never exec model text. Use structured tool calls with allowlisted actions and human approval for destructive ops.

rules.title: Agent tool exposes unrestricted shell
rules.message: Shell tools without a tight allowlist let a compromised prompt own the host.
rules.fix: Constrain tools to typed APIs; sandbox; require confirmation for filesystem and network side effects.
